guide.description: There's no separate inspection command here — ffmpeg prints a summary of what it wrote, and cat prints that same summary back out of the file whenever you need to check it again later.

exercises.title: Convert, then inspect
exercises.task: Convert raw-interview.mov to highlight.mp4, then use cat to print its summary.
hints: First convert with ffmpeg -i raw-interview.mov highlight.mp4
Then cat highlight.mp4 to see the summary
